section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in the study, including a short version of the revised self-leadership questionnaire, the Goal Orientation Scale by Button et al. (1996) (covering learning and performance orientations), Griffin et al.'s (2010) scale for proactive work role performance, and Griffin et al.'s (2010) scale for adaptive work role performance. Reliability coefficients and sample items are provided for each measure and its sub-dimensions.

PgoType.evidence_source: A sample item of the performance orientation scale (α = .82, p < 0.05) was 'I prefer to do things that I can do well rather than things that I do poorly.' This indicates a general performance orientation without distinguishing approach or avoidance.

AdaptMeasures.evidence_source: Adaptive work role performance was accessed using the Griffin et al. (2010) scale (α = .88, p < 0.05, 9 items). The reliability for each performance dimension was as follows: Individual task adaptivity (α = .81, p < 0.05, 'Adapted well to changes in core tasks'), team member adaptivity (α = .85, p < 0.05, 'Dealt effectively with changes affecting your work unit [e.g., new Members]'), and organization member adaptivity (α = .79, p < 0.05, 'Coped with changes in the way the organization operates'). The sample items are self-report statements.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in the study, including self-leadership (short version of revised self-leadership questionnaire by Houghton & Neck, 2002), goal orientation (16-item version by Button et al., 1996, distinguishing learning and performance orientations), proactive work role performance (Griffin et al.'s, 2010 scale), and adaptive work role performance (Griffin et al., 2010 scale).
